guides.title: Road Accident
guides.source: PLUS roadside safety: https://www.plus.com.my/road-safety/; Malaysian emergency services: https://www.malaysia.gov.my/en/my-initiative/cyber-security-and-disaster-response-and-recovery/tindak-balas-serta-pemulihan-bencana/malaysia-emergency-response-services-mers-999

steps.title: Protect yourself
steps.description: If possible, stop away from traffic and switch on hazard lights. On PLUS expressways, wait behind the roadside barrier when it is safe to leave the vehicle.

steps.title: Get help
steps.description: Call 999 for an emergency. On PLUS expressways, call 1800-88-0000 for roadside assistance. Give your location and explain the situation.

steps.title: Record information when safe
steps.description: Use the local incident form to note time, location, contact details and photographs. Stay out of traffic while recording information.

guides.title: Flat Tyre
guides.source: AA tyre guidance: https://www.theaa.com/breakdown-cover/advice/change-a-flat-tyre; AA breakdown safety: https://www.theaa.com/breakdown-cover/advice/what-to-do-if-you-break-down

steps.title: Find a safe stopping place
steps.description: Stop somewhere safe as soon as you notice a puncture. Switch on hazard lights if your vehicle obstructs traffic.

steps.title: Avoid roadside danger
steps.description: Do not attempt a wheel change on an expressway or beside moving traffic. Wait away from the vehicle where safe and contact roadside assistance.

steps.title: Use suitable assistance
steps.description: A wheel change needs the correct tools and knowledge. If you are unsure, ask for professional help. Follow your vehicle manual for any work in a safe location.

guides.title: Engine Overheating
guides.source: AAA overheating guidance: https://info.oregon.aaa.com/dealing-with-an-overheating-car/; PLUS roadside safety: https://www.plus.com.my/road-safety/

steps.title: Stop safely
steps.description: If the temperature warning appears or you see steam, find a safe place to stop and turn off the engine. Seek roadside assistance.

steps.title: Keep the cooling system closed
steps.description: Never remove a radiator or coolant pressure cap while the engine is hot. Hot pressurised coolant can cause serious burns.

steps.title: Wait for assistance
steps.description: Let the engine cool fully. On PLUS expressways, move behind the barrier when safe and call 1800-88-0000. Do not continue driving with an overheating engine.

guides.title: Battery Problems
guides.source: AA battery safety: https://www.theaa.com/breakdown-cover/advice/using-jump-leads; AA breakdown safety: https://www.theaa.com/breakdown-cover/advice/what-to-do-if-you-break-down

steps.title: Keep clear of traffic
steps.description: Do not try electrical repairs beside moving traffic. Use roadside assistance if your vehicle is in an unsafe location.

steps.title: Do not jump a damaged battery
steps.description: Never try to jump-start a battery that is leaking or visibly damaged. Incorrect connections may damage the vehicle or cause injury.

steps.title: Follow your vehicle manual
steps.description: Jump-start procedures vary. If you lack the correct equipment or are unsure about the procedure, ask a qualified roadside provider for help.

guides.title: Car Will Not Start
guides.source: AA starting guidance: https://www.theaa.com/breakdown-cover/advice/starting-a-car; AA breakdown safety: https://www.theaa.com/breakdown-cover/advice/what-to-do-if-you-break-down

steps.title: Check your surroundings
steps.description: Use hazard lights if you are obstructing traffic. Get to a safe waiting place before investigating the problem.

steps.title: Record what you notice
steps.description: Note warning lights, sounds and whether the engine turns over. Several faults can prevent starting; do not assume the battery is the cause.

steps.title: Request assistance
steps.description: Contact your roadside provider and explain the symptoms. Avoid roadside electrical repairs when you are unsure how to work safely.

guides.title: Vehicle Breakdown / Other Situations
guides.source: PLUS roadside safety: https://www.plus.com.my/road-safety/; AA breakdown safety: https://www.theaa.com/breakdown-cover/advice/what-to-do-if-you-break-down

steps.title: Stop away from traffic
steps.description: Pull into a safe stopping place if possible and turn on hazard lights. On PLUS expressways, use the emergency lane and wait behind the barrier when safe.

steps.title: If leaving would be unsafe
steps.description: If stranded in a live lane and you cannot safely leave, keep your seatbelt on, turn on hazard lights and call 999.

steps.title: Contact assistance
steps.description: Call your personal roadside contact or PLUSLine at 1800-88-0000 on PLUS expressways. Explain your location. Do not attempt repairs beside fast-moving traffic.
